detailed_descriptions.en: OPEN PACKS. SURVIVE THE HORDE. Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms. OPEN PACKS Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes. UPGRADE YOUR POWER Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force. SURVIVE THE HORDE Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can. TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer. …and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets. The cycle has repeated countless times. You're here to break it.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
OPEN PACKS. SURVIVE THE HORDE.

Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

OPEN PACKS

Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

UPGRADE YOUR POWER

Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

SURVIVE THE HORDE

Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS

Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.

…and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.

The cycle has repeated countless times.

You're here to break it.
